text:
Audemars Piguet's Royal Oak Jumbo in titanium uses a metal that acts like glass.

Its shiny bezel and middle links are bulk metallic glass, a palladium alloy cooled so fast its atoms never line up. The case is titanium, and the dial is smoked burgundy. Price is on request from AP.

The case is 39 mm wide and 8.1 mm thick, with an automatic movement. AP first tried this mix of metals on a one-off Royal Oak for the 2021 Only Watch charity auction, then released it in 2023.
